instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\surface_leak.dxf. Import surface_leak.dxf. Draw a gasket plate rectangle (0,0)-(170,90), four radius 5 bolt holes at (20,20), (150,20), (20,70), and (150,70), a serpentine leak path on layer SLOT through points (35,45), (65,65), (95,25), and (135,45), two CUTOUT rectangular inspection windows with opposite corners (70,15)-(100,30) and (70,60)-(100,75), and a CENTER datum line from (85,0) to (85,90). Add text ACAD-27. Use OUTLINE for the gasket plate rectangle, HOLE for bolt holes, SLOT for the leak path, CUTOUT for inspection windows, CENTER for the datum line, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
